deviations: Card fixes applied: (1) ground is the white-painted depot #F3F4F1 and racking is one bay frame (blue slotted uprights run only from the aisle directory down, not at page edges). Goods-in receiving bay, swap shelf, delivery notes, ledger extract, FAQ and floor-plan footer are below this frame. The sticky grey aisle beam is not drawn (static capture). Production-task fixes (image derivatives, scroll-padding contract) do not touch a sketch. Process: first render, one fix batch, then a second small density and QR-size tuning batch with a third render, slightly over the one-fix-round bound; the horizontal-overflow check found none.
selfVerdict: Covered up, it could only be this studio: huge black stencil headline, blue slotted racking uprights around the index, orange beam labels and a pick ticket on a white-painted ground, and every app on a bin row printing its own tracking and SDK counts. It is not a template: no card grid, no hero device, and the action (official badge plus QR, price) is in the first viewport as a bin label. Weak points: the desktop ledger leans toward a spreadsheet with grey, blue and orange uprights, and orange-and-blue racking is close to generic industrial. The lower half shows only aisle 1 and the start of aisle 2, so the Goods-in bay, swap shelf and journal are not judged here. The mobile first screen is long before the aisle directory shows, and a drawer needs a tap to reach the badge and QR for the rest of the catalogue. Strongest idea: the record (stocktake plus per-row declared data) is the opener and the navigation at once.
